about.title: The operating desk for how Arabic brands appear in AI answers.
about.lede: GeoSight tracks the prompts, providers, dialects, competitors, citations, and sentiment that decide whether your brand is visible when buyers ask AI for recommendations.
about.manifesto: Search is becoming conversational, regional, and model-mediated. Arabic brands need more than keyword ranks; they need a living readout of how AI systems explain the market, which competitors they trust, and what sources shape the answer.
